Alternatively, switching earlier doesn't help because in layer 2 you can only go backward, so you can't reach 2006 from any layer-2 node lower than 2006 except via switch from 1003.

So to get to 2006, the only incoming edges to 2006 are: from 1003 via switch (cost 5), and from... layer 2 edges into 2006 would be (v+N) -> (u+N) where u+N = 2006, i.e., u=1003, v=1004. Also switch from 2006 back to 1003... anyway.

min(dist[1003], dist[2006]) = min(1002, 1007) = 1002.
